csv_project_name: Design For Argosy Collegiate Charter MS Gym & 2nd Floor Reno
csv_scope_of_work: The school needs to complete a renovation of the gymnasium to address issues with the floor, a lack of proper heating and cooling and a need for additional square footage. There is a stage that can be removed. The school is also looking to create additional small group classroom space, office space for staff and creative storage solutions. There is a 2nd floor hallway and balcony area that could be well-suited for this. The building will need to be occupied during the school year, and these spaces must be functional for classes. There are about 8 weeks of availability during the summer when the building can be unoccupied.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Cost Estimating, Environmental Engineering/Planning/Design, Electrical Engineering, Fire Protection Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Utility Engineering
